verdict.rationale: GitLab presents itself as a Git-based platform covering source control. Its docs include a dedicated section on working with the Git version control system, and a community report confirms that importing full Git repository data from GitHub is straightforward. Duo Chat also has access to project commits, which implies commit history is stored and browsable. missing for 10: explicit documentation of repository creation and management workflows, explicit documentation of the commit history browsing UI or API, independent hands-on corroboration of history browsing.
